title: A request written in Swedish
why: Travellers write in their own language. The request is fully specified: the cheapest cancellable room midweek is the Classic on the Flexible rate. Answering in Swedish is preferred. The agent may show its cards in Swedish, so the script has a rule for a Swedish approval card; without it the scripted traveller once declined by accident and the run still passed.
message: Hej! Kan du boka ett rum på Casa Halcy för två vuxna, tisdag till torsdag nästa vecka? Vi vill kunna avboka gratis och vi vill inte ha frukost. Billigaste rummet räcker.
